<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex89022025-05-0511-17-26" status="finalized"> thugs chos nyid la mnyam par ma bzhag pa med pa yin gyi gzhan la bzhengs bzhugs yod par 'dod do || med na de mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par mi 'jug

     <pb n="54b"/>

        <lb n="54b1"/> par thal te | 'dod na <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5633">myang 'das kyi mdo</rs> dang 'gal lo || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3720">klu grub</rs> kyi <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3715">rtsa bshe</rs> las | <quote><lg><l>'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das ||</l> <l>gnyis ni yod pa ma yin te ||</l> <l>'khor ba yongs su shes pa la ||</l> <l>mya ngan 'das shes rab tu brjod ||</l></lg> </quote> ces so || rtogs pa la thobs pa zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog lo</rs> gsung lo || </seg></TEI>
source: 3_089_02 legs spyad nyi ma'i 'od zer mtshon cha'i rgyal po.xml
